blocks.x: Blockchain & Digital Trust in the Technology & SaaS context — regulation-first design, a fixed delivery rhythm, and outcomes your board can audit.

In Technology & SaaS, blockchain & digital trust delivers distributed-ledger programs where a shared, verifiable record has economic value: enterprise dlt networks for multi-party workflows, asset tokenization, smart contract engineering and audit, provenance and traceability, decentralized identity with verifiable credentials, and on-chain analytics for compliance. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: enterprise dlt network engineering, asset tokenization & digital assets, smart contract engineering & audit — delivered on Dataq Ledger and Dataq Sentinel with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Multi-sided marketplaces lack portable reputation/credential layers; verification friction suppresses liquidity.
Deploy frequency rises while incident load eats roadmap; error budgets exist in slide decks, not in release policy.
Teams bolt on LLM features with no cost telemetry, no eval put to work and no guardrails; margins erode silently per customer.

Delivery composes 6 services from the Blockchain & Digital Trust tower — Enterprise DLT Network Engineering, Asset Tokenization & Digital Assets, Smart Contract Engineering & Audit, Provenance, Traceability & Supply Chain Trust as the usual core — sequenced through the Dataq Method, with EU AI Act (as AI providers) obligations shaping the design from the first sprint.
Services we deploy in this sector

items: Permissioned networks for multi-party truth: governance, consensus and integration done institutionally.
Instruments as tokens: issuance, custody and lifecycle under securities-law discipline.
Contracts as production software: specification, formal verification and audit before value moves.
Proof, not paperwork: EUDR, DPP and chain-of-custody systems regulators and customers can verify.
Portable reputation/credentials for participants (verification friction down; liquidity up)
On-chain metered settlement where multi-party value flows (disputes reduced on shared evidence)
First line live within two quarters

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: EU AI Act (as AI providers) and SOC 2 / ISO 27001. Procurement-gating certification with evidence duties. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

The weekly rhythm below is identical across programs of this type. The first two weeks lock the baseline: your team and ours measure the current metric together and sign it. Weeks 3–8 carry the pilot on bounded scope — a single decision path, workflow, plant or portfolio — and a control owner on your side owns the evidence. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement, and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Missing a gate produces a documented decision to stop or redirect — never a silent extension.
